name: Military Service
overview: Scripture acknowledges military service as a significant aspect of human experience, affirming that God equips and strengthens His people for battle, as seen in David’s declaration that the Lord teaches his hands to fight (Psalms 144:1). Believers are called to courage and trust in God’s presence and protection, even when facing overwhelming odds or danger (Deuteronomy 20:1; Joshua 1:9; Psalms 23:4). The Bible also recognizes a divinely appointed season for war alongside peace (Ecclesiastes 3:8), and highlights the blessing upon nations that honor the Lord as their God (Psalms 33:12), underscoring the spiritual dimension of military service under God’s sovereign guidance.
